title: A timing metric must fail when the timed operation did not succeed
rule: When a bench or test times an operation against a budget (activation, scan, import), check its outcome too: the metric fails when the operation's items did not succeed (for activation: every face activated or clashed with an installed font), and the end-to-end test asserts the outcome counts, not only that a time was recorded. A regression that makes every item fail fast must turn the budget red, not green.
rationale: E6.6 (#79): `fm-bench activate` returned a time whatever the outcomes, and the bench end-to-end test checked only value > 0 and faces == 100, so an activator that failed all 100 faces quickly passed activation_100.
